name: Mattancherry Palace (Dutch Palace)
summary: Mattancherry Palace was built by the Portuguese and given to the Raja of Kochi in the mid-1500s; later Dutch renovations gave it the name Dutch Palace. It is known for its Ramayana murals and its gallery of portraits of the Kochi rulers.
highlights: Built by the Portuguese and given to the Raja of Kochi
Renovated by the Dutch in the 17th century, hence the Dutch Palace
Wall murals of scenes from the Ramayana
Portraits of the rulers of Kochi
In Mattancherry, near the Paradesi Synagogue
